list.name: pH-Down dose
list.textFormat: Demeter dosed pH-Down (ch1) — ml in the Demeter row

description: Pomona hydroponic tower — monitoring dashboard (card #222) + Demeter autodosing (card #278). Data: MQTT pomona/# ingested by the pomona-ingest Telegraf bridge into the InfluxDB pomona bucket (tags zone/metric, field value); pump watts come from the homeassistant bucket (HA InfluxDB export); dosing series are Demeter's demeter_* Prometheus metrics. Vertical markers on the pH and EC panels = a dose (red pH-Down, green nutrients). Delivered-ml stats net out the first $prime_ml ml per reagent (lines primed with water on commissioning).

panels.title: Unit
panels.description: pomona/unit/status (retained): online/offline as published by the firmware's MQTT LWT.

targets.query: from(bucket: "pomona") |> range(start: -7d) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "pomona_meta" and r.metric == "status" and r._field == "value") |> last() |> keep(columns: ["_value"]) |> rename(columns: {_value: "Unit"})

panels.title: Firmware
panels.description: pomona/unit/fw_version (retained).

targets.query: from(bucket: "pomona") |> range(start: -7d) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "pomona_meta" and r.metric == "fw_version" and r._field == "value") |> last() |> keep(columns: ["_value"]) |> rename(columns: {_value: "Firmware"})

panels.title: WiFi RSSI
panels.description: pomona/unit/rssi_dbm. > -67 dBm good (green), -80..-67 marginal (amber), < -80 weak (red).

targets.query: from(bucket: "pomona") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "pomona" and r.zone == "unit" and r.metric == "rssi_dbm" and r._field == "value") |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false) |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value"]) |> rename(columns: {_value: "RSSI"})

panels.title: Uptime
panels.description: pomona/unit/uptime_s — resets on reboot/OTA.

targets.query: from(bucket: "pomona") |> range(start: -7d) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "pomona" and r.zone == "unit" and r.metric == "uptime_s" and r._field == "value") |> last() |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value"]) |> rename(columns: {_value: "Uptime"})

panels.title: Reservoir
panels.description: pomona/water/level_points (0-4 probe points wet). 2 = OK (target fill), 1 = WRN low, 3-4 = WRN high, 0 CRIT — pump dry-run risk. Owner semantics 2026-09-01.

targets.query: from(bucket: "pomona") |> range(start: -7d) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "pomona" and r.zone == "water" and r.metric == "level_points" and r._field == "value") |> last() |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value"]) |> rename(columns: {_value: "Level"})

panels.title: EC (mS/cm)
panels.description: K=0.9745 probe. Shaded bands: 0.8-1.0 mS/cm (amber) = current TRANSPLANT target; 1.4-1.6 mS/cm (green) = established-plant target (plan v4). Steer dosing toward the band that matches the crop stage.

targets.query: from(bucket: "pomona") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "pomona" and r.zone == "water" and r.metric == "ec_ms_cm" and r._field == "value") |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false) |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value"]) |> rename(columns: {_value: "EC (mS/cm)"})

panels.title: pH
panels.description: Calibrated 2-point (7.00 / 4.00), validated at 10.01. Shaded band 5.8-6.2 = hydroponic target. Raw electrode voltage is on pomona/water/ph_raw_v if the calibration drifts.

targets.query: from(bucket: "pomona") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "pomona" and r.zone == "water" and r.metric == "ph" and r._field == "value") |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false) |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value"]) |> rename(columns: {_value: "pH"})

panels.title: Water temperature
panels.description: Reservoir water temperature (DS18B20). Hydroponic comfort zone roughly 18-24 °C.

targets.query: from(bucket: "pomona") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "pomona" and r.zone == "water" and r.metric == "temp_c" and r._field == "value") |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false) |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value"]) |> rename(columns: {_value: "Water °C"})

panels.title: Reservoir level
panels.description: pomona/water/level_points over time. 2 OK (green, target fill), 1 low / 3-4 high (amber), 0 CRIT dry (red). Owner semantics 2026-09-01.

targets.query: from(bucket: "pomona") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "pomona" and r.zone == "water" and r.metric == "level_points" and r._field == "value") |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false) |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value"]) |> rename(columns: {_value: "Level"})

panels.title: Canopy light (lux)
panels.description: BH1750, mounted BELOW the canopy: reads ~1/60 of true canopy lux. Use as the day/night RHYTHM indicator (photoperiod), not absolute light level.

targets.query: from(bucket: "pomona") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "pomona" and r.zone == "air" and r.metric == "lux" and r._field == "value") |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false) |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value"]) |> rename(columns: {_value: "Lux (sensor)"})

panels.title: Air — temperature & humidity
panels.description: BME280 @0x77. Humidity on the right axis.

targets.query: from(bucket: "pomona") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "pomona" and r.zone == "air" and r.metric == "temp_c" and r._field == "value") |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false) |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value"]) |> rename(columns: {_value: "Air °C"})

from(bucket: "pomona") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "pomona" and r.zone == "air" and r.metric == "humidity_pct" and r._field == "value") |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false) |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value"]) |> rename(columns: {_value: "Humidity %"})

panels.title: Air pressure
panels.description: BME280 barometric pressure — weather trend context.

targets.query: from(bucket: "pomona") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "pomona" and r.zone == "air" and r.metric == "pressure_hpa" and r._field == "value") |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false) |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value"]) |> rename(columns: {_value: "Pressure hPa"})

panels.title: Pump power (HA)
panels.description: sensor.pomona_pump_electric_consumption_w from the homeassistant bucket (HA InfluxDB export). Flat non-zero = pump running; the on/off rhythm is the irrigation cycle. Lamp switch state panel is a follow-up (entity id TBD).

targets.query: from(bucket: "homeassistant") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r.entity_id == "pomona_pump_electric_consumption_w" and r._field == "value") |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false) |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value"]) |> rename(columns: {_value: "Pump W"})

panels.title: Demeter mode
panels.description: shadow = decides + publishes, never doses. active = doses for real. Flipped via gitops (.config/<env>/pomona.yaml demeter.mode).

panels.title: pH-Down last 24 h vs cap (controller view)
panels.description: The CONTROLLER's rolling 24 h acid budget vs the 4 ml hard cap — pumped ml, prime included, because this is what gates dosing. At the cap Demeter stops dosing and raises an alert decision even if pH is still high. Net delivered ml are in the panels below.

panels.title: Nutrients last 24 h (net)
panels.description: ml of Nutrient A and B actually delivered in the rolling 24 h window, net of the $prime_ml ml water prime per line (max one 5 ml + 5 ml feed per 24 h). The controller's own budget counts pumped ml, prime included.

panels.title: Lockout remaining
panels.description: Seconds until Demeter may dose again (60 min after ANY dose, ours or manual; a fresh pod starts locked). 0 = dosing allowed.

panels.title: Last dose
panels.description: Time since the most recent dose Demeter executed (any reagent). Looks back 7 days so a controller restart does not blank it (the gauge is per process until 0.3.1 sets it from the ledger).

panels.title: Alert decisions (24 h)
panels.description: Decisions where a condition needs a human: acid cap reached with pH still high, pH < 5.4, EC > 1.1, water > 26.5 °C. Non-zero = look at pomona/demeter/decision.

panels.title: Delivered per day (ml, stacked, net of prime)
panels.description: Milliliters of reagent actually delivered per day, stacked by reagent (red pH-Down, greens Nutrient A/B), net of the first $prime_ml ml pumped per line (water prime). One bar per calendar day (UTC boundaries). Widen the time range to see the season.

panels.title: Dose events (ml pumped)
panels.description: Each bar is one dose: height = ml PUMPED (prime not subtracted — every pump run shows), colour = reagent. The same events are the vertical markers on the pH/EC panels above.

panels.title: Decisions by outcome
panels.description: What Demeter concluded each cycle (every 60 s): none = in band / unconfirmed; blocked = dose warranted but a guard (lockout, budget, stale, offline) said no; alert = no reagent for this; dose_* = a dose was issued (active) or would have been (shadow).

panels.title: Demeter reading age & unit online
panels.description: Age of the newest pH/EC/temp sample Demeter holds (must stay under the 120 s dosing-grade line) and the GIGA's online flag. Stale readings or an offline unit block every dose.

panels.title: Reagent remaining (%)
panels.description: Bottle content left = container_ml at the fill date minus ml pumped since (ADR-0002). Demeter alerts below 10 % and blocks a dose the bottle cannot cover. Refill = set container_ml to the new content and bump filled_on in .config/<env>/pomona.yaml.

panels.title: Reagent remaining (ml)
panels.description: Millilitres left per bottle (container at fill minus pumped since). -1 would mean the container size is not configured.

panels.title: Days left at the 7-day dosing rate
panels.description: remaining ml / (ml pumped in the last 7 days / 7). Capped at 999 when the rate is ~0. A planning number, not a rail — the bottle-low alert is the rail.

panels.title: Reagent level (ml)
panels.description: Bottle content over time, per reagent. Steps down on each dose; jumps up on a refill (new filled_on). Widen the range to see consumption trends.

panels.title: Mixing & pump
panels.description: Demeter mixing = it holds pomona/pump/override=on around a dose (15 min, then auto; ADR-0003). pump running = the GIGA's actual pomona/pump/request (its schedule OR Demeter's override; the level interlock can veto). dose pending verdict = a dose whose response is not yet judged — the verdict needs ≥ 10 min of pump running.

panels.title: Mixed time since the pending dose
panels.description: Pump-on seconds accumulated since the last dose (from pomona/pump/request). The brain judges the dose's pH response only past the 600 s line — until then a 'no response' cannot be declared. Resets on each dose.

panels.title: No-response streak
panels.description: Consecutive pH-Down doses that produced no measurable drop on a MIXED tank. At 3 Demeter stops dosing acid and alerts — dry line, empty bottle or dead pump. Cleared by a dose that responds.

panels.title: Last dose response (pH drop)
panels.description: pre-dose pH minus the settled trough of the last judged pH-Down dose. Around 0 = no response; the learned model expects k·ml − b (k ≈ 1.36 pH/ml, b ≈ 0.37 as of 2026-09-11).

list.name: prime_ml
list.label: Prime offset (ml/reagent)
list.description: The dosing lines were primed with WATER on commissioning (2026-09-10), so the first ml pumped per channel deliver no reagent. Delivered-ml panels subtract this per reagent. Set to 0 once the lines have been primed with reagent.
